Orlynvah (sulopenem etzadroxil and probenecid) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-450249  
Guideline Name 
Orlynvah (sulopenem etzadroxil and probenecid)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
1/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Orlynvah  
Approval Length 
5 Day(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of an uncomplicated urinary tract infection (uUTI)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient is 18 years of age or older  


--- PDF page 1347 ---
Page 1347 
 
AND 
 
3 - Trial and inadequate response, contraindication or resistance to one alternative oral 
antibacterial treatment option (e.g., trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, ciprofloxacin)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Infection caused by one of the following:  
• 
Escherichia coli  
• 
Klebsiella pneumoniae  
• 
Proteus mirabilis  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
12/17/2025  
Updated criterion 4 "infection with" to "infection caused by", no chang
e to clinical intent.
